'Bridge Man of India' Girish Bharadwaj dies at 76

Girish Bharadwaj, known as the 'Bridge Man of India', has passed away at the age of 76. He was recognized for his work in constructing approximately 140 low-cost bridges, primarily serving remote villages. His contributions focused on improving connectivity in underserved areas.
